an4.25:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] nayidaṃ bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhanatthaṃ, na janalapanatthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ, na itivādappamokkhānisaṃsatthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātūti.
an4.25:1.2: atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvaratthaṃ, pahānatthaṃ, virāgatthaṃ, nirodhatthanti.
